## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Surface write failures before announcing success — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` discards `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns zero. The broad handler also suppresses permission and disk-space errors. — Users and calling programs receive false confirmation and cannot identify why their requested report was not saved. — Fix: Propagate write failures or return an actionable error with a nonzero result, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
